name: Navige
summary: Cuts AI agent and LLM spend without changing the output: routes each call, blocks wasted work and reuses work already done. Watchtower is free forever.
description: Cuts AI agent and LLM spend without changing the output: routes each call, blocks wasted work and reuses work already done. Watchtower is free forever.

pricing.details: Watchtower 0 € forever, no card, no time limit — connect as many agents as you like; weekly report of what they cost and what you could save; Watchtower only watches, agents run as today. When Navige is allowed to save: most months, 20% of the savings (1 € of every 5 € it saves), when it saves 41 € or more in a month; quiet months, a flat 8 € if it saves less than 41 €. This is a share-of-savings model, not a fixed seat price. Official wording is also “we save you 5 €, you keep 4 €.”
pricing.label: Freemium
